title: Built for the problem, not for show
headSub: A capable model will build anything you describe, so scope is the hard part. I built what this job search needed and left the rest, knowing the context can change.
head: Left out
Why it wasn't needed here
What would bring it back

cells.text: the job is search, score, draft - nothing for the agent to go act on
a use case where the agent must take an action, with the cost caps extended to cover it
structured context covers a single job search
cross-session recall, or many profiles, that context cannot carry
the reversible steps are cheap to redo
more irreversible actions added to the flow
the tool's job ends at the resume; a person tracks their own applications
stays out by choice - the apply decision is the human's

takeaway.text: I built what this problem needed, not what the field is excited about. {{amber:Context decides what to leave out, and context can change.}}
